source: All site cameras combined: d1 up, D1 Entrance, D2 (pit), D2 up, D3 up, D2-D3, Pergola

days.notes: loads 0-2; Hitachi parked all day

Three loads left: about 10:25 (a yellow tipper loaded at the near pile 09:08-10:25), 13:31 (the green El Hajj Mercedes) and 15:25 (the yellow "M.P." tipper, which came in at 14:55). The orange Hitachi boom shows at the far end at 13:31 and 14:23. Loading proves a machine worked, but D2 cannot see which one or for how long.
minimum (no morning footage)
Hitachi ~7.3 if there was a lunch stop

Saturday. Three yellow tippers came in empty and went out loaded: in 08:24 / out 08:48, in 10:32 / out 10:57, in 13:24 / out 13:50. That is roughly 3 x 25 min of Komatsu loading plus work on the pile. The Hitachi cannot be resolved. A white diesel tanker was on site 15:21-15:36.
Sunday
Hitachi parked from 11:03
no camera recorded this day
minimum

Two loads: a yellow tipper in 07:52 / out loaded 08:15, and the green El Hajj truck in 08:44 / out loaded 09:05. There are only 13 events and none from 09:28 to 15:12, so machine time after 09:30 is unknown. A motion event at 02:27 at night (a light on the track).
15 Aug holiday
Sunday

Three loads: a yellow tipper in 14:17 / out loaded 14:41; a yellow tipper in 15:44 / out loaded 16:05; a tipper in at 17:11, then a white MHANNA Mercedes tipper out at 17:36, which is after normal hours. A silver diesel tanker was at the camera 16:07-16:25. The morning shows people only, so the work was probably afternoon only.
minimum

The Komatsu (bucket, KOMATSU on the counterweight) works close to D2 from 09:43 to 12:18, with a dense burst from 11:58 to 12:18. It is parked from 13:37. No tippers came. The machine at the far end is not seen working.
minimum
Saturday. The orange Hitachi breaks at the far end from 07:26 to about 09:29 (heavy dust at 08:23). It stays parked in one spot from 12:21 to 17:06. No tippers.
Sunday

The Komatsu works close to D2 almost continuously from 12:15 to after 13:13, through the lunch hour (69 events in the 13:00 hour). A machine works at the far end 14:19-15:40. No tippers. This is the busiest D2 day in the set (135 events).
minimum
loads 0-3, camera view moved

Saturday. The orange Hitachi works at the far end 06:17-10:18; its position changes between tiles. One load: a yellow-bed tipper on D2 at 08:10, which reverses out at 08:22 (Entrance). After that, cars only. It rained from about 16:24 and again around 22:00. The night events on both cameras are rain streaks and a dog. Not suspicious.
Sunday
machine swap on a lowboy 08:15-08:51 via the top road

D2 up starts recording at 18:28, so the daytime comes from D2 + Entrance + d1 up (unchanged from earlier reviews). Komatsu works 09:16-13:37 and loads 3 green El Hajj Actros tippers; Hitachi parked all day. At 18:28 D2 up shows the Komatsu parked in the pit and the Hitachi parked at the top. Night 1-2 Sep: only IR flicker and the evening colour/IR switch (about 19:36); no vehicle or person.

Correction: D2 up shows the Komatsu parked in the pit with the SAME pose 07:50-11:07 (zoomed every 5 min), so the earlier D2 interval 10:28-11:25 was mostly idle. It moves 11:08-11:29, then stays parked at the top-left all afternoon. The Hitachi arrives at the right edge 12:14 and breaks there (partly out of frame) until 15:38, then drives to the left; no lunch stop visible. Two dark visitor cars on the yard 10:44-11:08. No tipper.

D2 up watches the upper yard all day. The Komatsu is parked at the top until the tanker comes; the Hitachi is parked at the lower-left and leaves twice to work. The Mhanna Petroleum tanker fuels the Komatsu with a hose 15:19-15:41. The Dodge, its bed full of green jerrycans, pulls up against the Komatsu at 15:42, about 1 min after the tanker leaves. Earlier, 08:07-08:25, the same Dodge with cans was parked against the Hitachi, with a man on the Hitachi deck at 08:09.

days.confidence: medium (Hitachi up to about 4.5 h possible: away 10:32-15:27 but its work is unseen)
days.notes: The Dodge with cans comes in 09:17 and parks against the parked Komatsu until about 09:56; a man handles cans in the bed (09:30). 09:44-09:51: Dodge hood open and a person on the Komatsu deck. The Komatsu moves off right after, at 09:56. The Hitachi leaves its spot 10:32 and comes back 15:27. 15:57-16:10: a dark sedan parks tight against the parked Hitachi with two men at its side. Dodge at the parking 16:10-16:11 (D2).

Saturday. D2 up looks at the upper yard until 08:57; at 09:00 it is re-aimed down at the pit and stays on the pit for the rest of the period, so the parking yard is no longer watched. Dodge with cans parks alongside the parked Komatsu 08:01-08:22; a man on the Komatsu engine deck at 08:15. Hitachi raised from 2.2 h (d1 up, from 09:34) to about 3.3 h. Camera restarts at 04:57, 05:53 and 23:09 (new file + PTZ swing); no person.

days.confidence: high for hours; night lights unexplained
days.notes: Sunday, no work (D2 up sees only the pit, not the parked machines). 04:14: the lamp at the upper gate (top-left of frame, fixed light on a pole) comes on; at the same minute D2 logs a PERSON and the Entrance camera shows a dog at the pile, and another animal at 04:35. 21:00:51: new file / PTZ restart (white close-up is the housing), not a person. 23:40:48-23:42:20: a bright light with a beam at the same gate position for about 90 s, with no Entrance event; not identified.

D2 up confirms d1 up. Hitachi breaks without a pause 08:24-14:14. Tipper 1 waits on the top yard 10:47-10:54 and is loaded 10:57-11:11. Parking yard out of view, so no diesel event can be checked. 01:13-01:20: gate lamp on, with Entrance events showing nothing (likely an animal).

D2 up matches d1 up for the Komatsu. A white tipper cab is on the top yard at 13:26. The hub shows 1 load; the Entrance review plus the d1 up loading 13:04-13:10 give 2. The Dodge-beside-machine events of the day (11:50-13:30 at the Hitachi, 15:40-17:03 at the Komatsu with the hood open, from d1 up) are outside D2 up's view. 19:17-19:35: gate lamp on and the upper track lit, after hours; Entrance events at 19:13 and 19:31 show nothing.

D2 up (view: the pit near the entrance pile and the new stone wall) sees the Komatsu working in view 10:14-10:48, at the left edge 10:50-11:15, then 11:18-11:48 and 12:00-12:57 (loading a tipper 12:24-12:36). It is parked 12:59-13:36 (lunch) and works again 13:39-15:18. The Hitachi is never in D2 up view. This confirms the hub 4.4 h. At 14:45:15-14:46:29 D2 up was panned by its motor onto the wall, so after that it sees only the edge of the work area.

D2 up looks down the wall. The Hitachi breaks at its left edge from 08:11 to 11:59, with the pose changing from tile to tile. It is out of view 11:59-12:12, its only stop (a short lunch), then breaks again 12:15-14:48. It is out of view from 14:51, with nothing after. That is about 6.3 h, more than the hub 4.5 h, which came from D2 09:30-14:37. The range is 5.8-6.5 h because part of the boom is cut off at the edge. No tipper.

D2 up fills the 06:30-11:28 gap in d1 up. Nothing moves in its view all morning, so there was no breaking in the pit before 11:28. Komatsu work further up cannot be ruled out. The afternoon glimpses match d1 up: Komatsu bucket at 11:51-11:54, 13:00, 13:36 and 15:04-15:05; Hitachi breaking 14:18-14:24. Loads: the d1 up review lists 4 on the Entrance camera; the hub has 3, marked as a minimum. I keep 4.
Saturday. D2 up motion matches d1 up exactly (08:30-09:00 and 11:30-12:50 at the pit edge). The afternoon is quiet. The 18:30 automatic sweep of D2 up happens every evening.

Sunday, no work. D2 up made full pan sweeps at 04:08 (a camera restart: new files tp00134/135 start at 04:08), at 08:00:00 and at 18:30:05. Each time it returned to the same view. The 08:00 and 18:30 sweeps recur on other days at the same minute, so they are automatic, not a person.

D3 up confirms the hub: breaker motion at the wall from about 08:10, tipper loading at 12:18-12:40 and 13:40-13:58 (2 loads), no work after about 15:05. The night of 13/14 and 14/15 only shows road traffic, town lights and IR noise. No Dodge or can activity seen at the machines.

Hours and loads confirmed on D3 up (Komatsu in the pit 07:50-08:30, trucks loaded 10:00-10:30 and 11:10-11:40, breaker work to about 14:15). NEW after-work events at the parked Hitachi, which stood beside the jerrycan pile at the fence: at 16:29-16:32 an old white Mercedes sedan was parked right against the Hitachi with its boot open and a man between the car and the machine, a yellow jerrycan on the ground beside the Hitachi track. From 16:56 to about 17:22 the Dodge (bed of cans) was parked at the fence pile beside the Hitachi; two men worked at the Hitachi breaker/cans at 17:05, then one at the Dodge bed at 17:11. The Mercedes stayed beside the Hitachi throughout.

D3 up confirms the hub hours and the single load (loading 09:00-09:40). It also confirms the two known events from a second angle: the Dodge parked against the parked Hitachi with a man between them 08:36-09:00, and the night car at 19:19-19:27 that drove up to the parked Komatsu and stopped by the jerrycan pile.

Hitachi: d1 up 08:48-10:18, plus a short move 16:55-17:00 that D3 up shows (the Hitachi was turned round beside the parked cars while people were on it) = about 1.6 h. Tanker beside the Hitachi 14:46-14:56 confirmed. At 16:54 two men sit on the Hitachi engine deck, a white pickup alongside, the Dodge with cans parked at the fence pile a few metres behind; at 17:03 two men at the Hitachi breaker. The RAV4 (silver SUV) is in the yard 14:46-14:58.

Hours as hub. D3 up confirms 07:37-07:43: the Hitachi engine hood is open with a man on its deck, the Dodge parked right behind it between the two machines, jerrycans at the fence pile. Night: heavy rain and lightning 19:58-20:15. At 20:09:24-20:09:30 a point light with a reflection on the wet track appears just beyond the parked Komatsu for about 6 s; it may be a torch or a vehicle lamp, or a lightning artefact. No vehicle is seen arriving or leaving. Unresolved.

Saturday. D3 up confirms both machines parked side by side all day (motion 10:50-12:10 is camera sway and changing light). The silver BMW is seen beside the parked Komatsu at 08:01-08:07 then leaves. Nothing at night.

Sunday. Machines parked all day on D3 up. At 01:23-01:25 D3 up restarted and ran its PTZ self-test sweep (frames of the lens housing and bushes), which is a camera event, not a visitor. Night clusters are IR noise and road lights.

d1 up was off until 12:25. D3 up covers the morning: the Hitachi starts (exhaust smoke) at about 08:00 and breaks at the wall 08:05-09:20, drives down to the lower track 09:20-09:28 and stands beside the Komatsu until about 09:56, then breaks again 10:00-12:51 without a lunch stop, and drives up by 12:54. With d1 up 13:47-14:57: Hitachi 08:05-09:20 + 10:00-12:51 + 13:47-14:57 = about 5.3 h (hub 3.0). The Komatsu works on the lower track by the fence 07:56-09:27, climbs into the pit 09:30-09:51 and is parked again by 10:00; with d1 up 13:03-13:38 = about 2.6 h (hub 1.2). U3 up shows the orange machine at the wall in the same period. No tipper on D3 up (0 loads stands). Before work 07:49-08:01 the Dodge stops beside the Hitachi with a man at its track. Afternoon 15:41-16:03 the Dodge (cans in bed) is parked nose to the parked Komatsu; a man in yellow is up on the Komatsu deck at 15:43 and then at the Dodge bed at 15:47.

Hours as hub; D3 up shows the two tippers loading about 11:20-11:35 and 12:30-12:42. Before work at 07:42-07:46 a man in blue is on the Hitachi engine deck with the hood open, the Dodge parked beside the Komatsu. At 15:29-15:35 two men at the Dodge bed (packed with green jerrycans) parked at the fence can pile, right below the parked Komatsu.

d1 up was off until 14:07, and D2 is event-only. D3 up sees the wall continuously: the Hitachi breaks 07:56-09:44, drives down and stands beside the Komatsu on the lower track 09:44-10:30, then breaks again 10:32-14:02 with the boom pose changing every few minutes and no lunch stop, and is on the lower track by 14:04. With d1 up 15:15-15:59: Hitachi 1.8 + 3.5 + 0.75 = about 6.1 h (hub 2.3). The Komatsu moves 10:02-10:40 then stays parked = about 0.6 h (hub 0.4). No tipper (0 loads). Before work 07:44-07:56 the Dodge drives up to the parked Komatsu and stops nose-in against it.

Hub figures confirmed (D3 up shows the Hitachi breaking in the yard 10:30-12:10 and the trucks; U3 up has gaps). Before work 07:26-07:40 the Dodge is parked right beside both machines with exhaust smoke from a machine. 08:10-08:56 the Hitachi parks against the Dodge at the fence can pile. Tanker beside the Hitachi 11:34-11:50 while a tipper is loaded at the Komatsu. At 13:40-13:58 the Hitachi stands still with its attachment down at the fence can pile and a man walks there.

D3 up (gaps 00:10-06:27 and 12:00-12:30 on the card) confirms the Hitachi breaking 07:36-08:14 and 10:50-12:25 and the 11:45-11:58 loading. After work at 15:48-15:59 the Dodge with cans is parked tight against the Hitachi, with two men standing at the Hitachi.
Saturday. D3 up confirms both machines parked side by side 07:44-18:30 (motion is camera sway and fog after 17:00). Night 19:45-23:00 is fog and IR. No visitor at the machines.
Sunday. D3 up and U3 up: both machines parked all day, no vehicle at the machines, no truck. Night 26/27 and 27/28: only road headlights beyond the fence and IR noise. Hub figures confirmed (0/0/0).

D3 up has no footage 06:55-11:27 (card gap); U3 up and the rest agree with the hub (Hitachi breaking 11:08-11:29 and 12:32-15:56, Komatsu loading 2 Scania trucks). Lunch: the Dodge is parked near the camera 12:33-13:38 while both machines stand idle up the track. Hub confirmed.

D3 up confirms the morning the hub lacked: from 08:05 the Dodge is parked against the parked Hitachi and Komatsu at the top of the track; a man in a yellow shirt climbs on the Hitachi deck (08:07), then on the Komatsu (08:12), then handles a yellow can at the Dodge (08:16-08:25) before the Hitachi starts (engine smoke 08:25). Hitachi working thereafter matches the hub (6.5 h); U3 up shows no truck. Hub figures kept.

Hours/loads: D3 up agrees with the hub (2 Astra loads 10:46 and 12:42 - truck seen leaving at 12:40-12:50; Hitachi breaking near the camera 12:24-12:51). New: at 13:55 the Hitachi stops work and drives to the jerrycan pile at the back fence; the Dodge parks nose-in at it 13:56-14:02, a man climbs onto the Hitachi deck by the cab (13:57:46) and works at the Dodge bed; the Hitachi then stands at the pile, idle, 13:55-15:13 (rain), with the Dodge parked a few metres away 14:02-15:13. This is the hub's "Hitachi out of view 13:52-15:17" - it was parked at the cans, not just sheltering. Morning 07:48-07:53: Dodge parked against the Hitachi, man at the Dodge door, then on the Hitachi deck with the engine hood raised.

D3 up: tanker at the Hitachi 07:17-07:30 (confirms the hub correction: Hitachi, not Komatsu). 08:06-08:41 the Dodge is parked against the Hitachi, which stands at the back-fence spot near the camera; a man walks between them (08:23). Hitachi leaves at 08:44 and breaks at the far face 08:47-11:56; Komatsu parked mid-track all day; the white Renault tipper at 09:20-09:27 leaves without a load (confirmed). Lunch 12:30-13:30: Dodge parked beside the parked Hitachi (hub already lists it). Hub confirmed.

D3 up: 07:30-07:42 Dodge parked against the Hitachi/Komatsu at the top of the track, Hitachi engine smoke 07:33 (as hub). Hitachi leaves 07:44 and breaks at the far face; Komatsu works 12:09-12:20 as hub. No truck. Hub confirmed.
D3 up: Dodge parked beside the Komatsu 07:29-10:10 (as hub). Hitachi breaking from 07:49; 2 loads as hub. D2 up 3 Oct agrees. Hub confirmed.
Sunday. D3 up, U3 up and D2 up: both machines parked in one pose all day; nobody at them. Night events are road lights. Hub confirmed (0/0/0).
D3 up: Dodge against the Hitachi 07:30-07:46 (as hub), Hitachi smoke 07:42-07:50. No new events. Hub confirmed.
No change; D3 up and D2 up agree with the hub (4 loads). U3 up was turned to the road from the evening of 6 Oct and no longer sees the machines.
No change. U3 up looks at the road (no machines). D3 up / D2 up agree with the hub.
No change. D3 up / D2 up agree with the hub.
No change. D3 up: Dodge parked at the jerrycan pile from 07:34 (as hub). Evening 17:08 tanker as hub; 18:00-21:30 only lights on the road beyond the fence.

days.footage: D3 up, U3 up, D2 up (until the cards were collected ~18:27)
days.notes: New day (no hub figures). Footage ends ~18:25-18:30 when both D2 up and D3 up are handled/moved (card collection). Hitachi: parked in the pit overnight; 07:07-07:16 a man on its rear deck with the engine hood up (D2 up); 07:27-07:59 the Komatsu is parked nose-to-nose against it, a man on its deck; 08:03-08:07 Hitachi drives to the back-fence jerrycan pile and parks beside the Dodge until 09:48 (idle 1 h 40 min, boom moves only 08:58-09:04 while a man in a yellow vest goes between the Dodge and the machine); 09:48-12:51 breaks in the pit (D2 up, pose changes every frame); 12:54-13:05 repositions; 13:05-18:24 stands with the boom raised in ONE pose (D2 up crops 13:09-18:25 identical) - idle, not breaking. Hitachi = 0.1+0.1+3.05+0.15 = 3.4 h (range 3.2-3.6). Komatsu: 07:27-07:32 drives in; 07:59-09:48 loads truck 1 (08:09-08:24), moves rock 08:30-09:18, loads truck 2 (09:21-09:39), parks; 10:38-11:00 loads truck 3 at the bottom of the track by D3 up and parks mid-track; idle after. Komatsu = 0.1+1.8+0.35 = 2.25 h. Loads: 3 white 8x4 tippers, out about 08:26, 09:40, 10:50 (D2 up + D3 up). U3 up points at the road (no machines). RAV4/BMW not identified (D3 up does not see the gate; only the Dodge at the fence).
